title: M5GFX #441 review: reserve board id 158 for M5UnitPoEP4X

execution.environment: macOS arm64 read-only diff and source review; host g++ (Apple clang 21.0.0) static_assert compile check of lgfx/boards.hpp; local loopback Device Service has 36 profiles with ESP32-P4 only as tab5; upstream GitHub Actions provided build and host board-detection test evidence

checks.detail: PR #441 OPEN, not draft, author TinyuZhao, English title with empty body, 0 comments and 0 reviews before review, mergeable MERGEABLE
head bb02d2e7cef83214fd3e54e2dcfd4c52ac51268e, base 43a87193f898f998edf79c5fb99b166d11ee1eaf (= develop tip); diff against base is 1 file, +1 line

158 is the next free non-display value after board_M5StampP4XHub = 157 and stays below board_M5AtomDisplay = 192; no duplicate with 148, 157, 201, or any existing enumerator
minimal TU with five static_asserts (value 158, distinct from 148/157/201, below 192) compiles with g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I src -fsyntax-only, exit 0
placed after the board_M5StamP4XHub alias inside the non-display block; name follows board_M5UnitPoEP4 (148) plus the X suffix used by board_M5StampP4X (156)
git grep at head finds only the declaration itself: no esp32p4_boards[] entry, no SDL title case, no fixture or generated-table entry; no existing runtime path changes

select_fixed_board() looks the value up in esp32p4_boards[] and returns nullptr on a miss (detection_package.inl:65-86); M5GFX::init_impl() then logs 'Fixed board:%u is not supported by this chip' and returns false (M5GFX.cpp:910-929), so id 158 is reserved but not yet selectable

same author previously landed bare id reservations: board_M5UnitPoEP4 added alone in f4923a7 (2026-01-22) and board_M5StamP4XHub = 157 added alone in 8d036e1 (2026-11-04), the latter renamed the next day in dc21d40; a one-line id reservation matches project practice

upstream GitHub Actions at head bb02d2e: 39/39 checks SUCCESS, including 'host' (Board detection host tests) and 'translation unit consistency'; Arduino 2.0.17/3.1.3/3.3.0/3.3.13/4.0.0, m5stack_core 2.1.4, ESP-IDF 5.1.6/5.4.3/5.5.2/6.0.2
no Unit PoE-P4X hardware on this host; neither power-on nor display behaviour was exercised

the diff adds one unreferenced enum constant with no executable runtime path; the local Device Service has 36 profiles and its only ESP32-P4 profile is tab5, with no Unit PoE-P4/P4X model; a firmware built with fixed board 158 would only reach the unsupported-board branch
detector, esp32p4_boards[] entry, fixture and SDL title mapping for 158 are outside this PR and were not validated

notes: PR left OPEN; exactly one English comment posted; no close, no push, no change to m5stack/M5GFX.
Evidence class is code-level verification plus upstream CI compile/test. Hardware and virtual-device validation are NOT RUN.
The ID is a reservation only: it cannot be selected through fixed board until a board_entry_t lands, which is called out in the review as informational and non-blocking.
